messages.subject: ggsave fails on large width
parts:
Hi,

I incorrectly specified the 'width' and 'height' options of ggsave (to
a png file) to 1000 (as I incorrectly thought the dimension is in
pixel), this renders not only the R session but also my whole mac
machine unresponsive. I'm not exactly clear what is done in ggsave,
but I think that there better be some kind of check to prevent users
from supplying too large dimension. Or there is any other trick from
preventing the system break-down from happenning?

--
Regards,
Peng

messages.subject: Re: ggsave fails on large width
